digest.component_or_area: plan review signing and manifest attestation
propositions: Every newly certified plan review must emit exactly one deterministic signed pin per direct child and prerequisite, sorted lexicographically by role then canonical ID, before LLM evaluation.

PlanRelationSnapshot must preload all ticket states store-wide including archived tickets to discover inbound blockers without calling find_inbound_relationships, then normalize and deduplicate relations within each role.

Pin collection must raise PlanRelationSnapshotError with exact reason enum (missing-target, ambiguous-reference, malformed-reference, reducer-error, canonical-id-mismatch, store-read-failure) and emit unsigned INDETERMINATE before any LLM call, never producing partial pins or tracebacks.
tracker_head_sha() must verify clean working tree via git status --porcelain and git ls-files -u, then return 40-hex HEAD; all git/IO/path/output failures map to store-read-failure.

manifest.py must parse and validate plan-material-pin lines appearing after verified-at-sha and before dep lines, collapsing duplicate role+ID edges and rejecting malformed fingerprints or unknown roles.

All plan-review signing paths (ordinary sign, progressive drift refresh, re-sign) must call collect_plan_relation_snapshot and emit complete current pins deterministically; deleted targets prevent refresh/re-sign until relationship repair.
